part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `contentNodeShifter.Insert` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:820): when a changed page/resource replaced an existing node in the page trees, the old node was only marked stale in some code paths — and in the `contentNodeIs`/`resourceSources` cases it was marked stale even when the replacement was the same object, while the plain `*pageState` replacement never marked the old (now-orphaned) page stale. Since stale-marking is what drives `resolveAndClearStateForIdentities` to reset dependent page outputs on server rebuilds, related pages never re-rendered.

The fix (matching upstream commit f014d765): mark the old node stale only when it's actually being replaced by a different node (`if newp != old { resource.MarkStale(...) }`) in all three branches.
